**Finding: compliant (preferred level).**

The APCN 2 Construction & Maintenance Agreement imposes no MFN obligation on Teleglobe USA Inc.

- **Subparagraph 15.2 (p0220)** is the only MFN-style covenant in the document: transiting facilities must be furnished "on terms and conditions which shall be no less favorable than those granted to another Carrier." That duty is imposed on the **Terminal Parties** under Paragraph 15.1.
- **Definition (s) (p0064)** lists the Terminal Parties as China Telecom, CWHKTI, Chunghwa Telecom, KDD, Korea Telecom, NTT Com, PLDT, SingTel and Telekom Malaysia. Teleglobe USA Inc. is **not** one of them, so we sit on the benefiting side as a Party/Carrier.
- **Subparagraph 17.2 (p0225)** ("reasonable and non-discriminatory" arrangements) likewise binds the Terminal Party, again in our favour.
- Targeted searches for "most favoured/favored", "favourable/favorable", "no less", "non-discriminatory", and third-party price-matching language returned nothing that burdens us.

Because the preferred position is satisfied, the fallback elements (defined product, 12-month term, like-for-like carve-outs) are not engaged, and no redline was proposed — the counterparty-granted MFN in 15.2 should be preserved as drafted.
